ProkBox file header (owner decision, 2026-10-20: GPL v2 or later, attributed
to the owner).  Every file ProkBox adds carries it; upstream Rockbox files
that are only edited keep their own header untouched.

Generate it instead of typing it:

    python3 scripts/prokbox_header.py FILE...     # new file, or fix an old header
    python3 scripts/prokbox_header.py --dry FILE  # preview

Generators that write C/asm/header files call prokbox_header.stamp(path) (or
prokbox_header.convert(text, ext)) so a regenerated file carries it too.

Rules
  - Year: the year the file was first added (git log --follow --diff-filter=A).
  - No email address.  No Apple names or marks.
  - The purpose line(s) go where shown; keep an existing purpose verbatim.
  - A file ADAPTED from Rockbox code keeps every original upstream copyright
    line (listed beside the owner's line) and adds, after the owner's line:
        Portions derived from Rockbox (rockbox.org).
  - A file only EDITED from upstream keeps its header as it is.
  - Docs (.md) and data files get no code header.
  - Python, shell, make and similar use the '#' variant (shebang line first).

---- C / C++ / asm / headers / linker scripts -------------------------------

/***************************************************************************

 *   Player      |    |     |  | \/ (  <_> )|    <  |    |   \(  <_> ) >    <
